params.target: one-month-ahead PMI contraction label d_(t+1), threshold 50.0
params.schedule: identical to approach2_regime.py (interface.md §5.1): expanding window, origins 2019-12-31..2026-09-30, targets 2020-01..2026-10, one fold per target month

safe_probit.description: probit GLM (statsmodels Binomial, probit link) on the standardized origin-row design z_u (last window row = information set F_u); probabilities clipped to [0,1]; ridge alpha selected per fold by validation-tail Brier from {0.1, 1, 10} plus an unpenalized candidate — never test data

safe_rnn.description: LSTM/GRU per-seed per-fold predictions reused from the approach2_regime.py headline run (same schedule, folds, seeds; regenerate via code/approach2_regime.py)

leaky_rnn.description: identical RNNClassifier training pipeline, but the RAW unshifted panel is used as the feature window: every series is treated as published at its reference month-end, ignoring publication_lag_months from data/metadata.json
leaky_rnn.validity: INVALID as a predictive model — intentional leakage demonstration only; it must never be reported alongside valid forecasts without this label

params.validation: expanding-window walk-forward; 24-month label tail inside each training window for early stopping + threshold selection
params.residual_nondeterminism: CPU LSTM multithreaded reductions may vary in last bits; seeds fixed for initialization and batch order

leakage_premium.definition: leaky metric minus safe metric on the identical folds; a positive Brier gap means the leaky model merely looked better because of information-set violations

lstm.note: AUC/Brier of the leaky arm are INVALID: they quantify the leakage premium only.

gru.note: AUC/Brier of the leaky arm are INVALID: they quantify the leakage premium only.
